description: Na₂GeF₆ is Hydrophilite-derived structured and crystallizes in the trigonal P321 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six F atoms to form NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent GeF₆ octahedra, corners with six equivalent NaF₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one GeF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-61°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.38 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six F atoms to form distorted NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent GeF₆ octahedra, corners with six equivalent NaF₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent GeF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-61°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.19-2.29 Å. There are two inequivalent Ge sites. In the first Ge site, Ge is bonded to six F atoms to form GeF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaF₆ octahedra and edges with three equivalent NaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-45°. All Ge-F bond lengths are 1.81 Å. In the second Ge site, Ge is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form GeF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaF₆ octahedra and edges with three equivalent NaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 49°. All Ge-F bond lengths are 1.81 Å. There are three inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one Ge atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one Ge atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one Ge atom.
